bio: While wine may not be the only ingredient on the menu, it is clearly a prominent feature of this cheerful bustling bistro. The expert sommelier’s wine selection (excellent tips) is perfectly paired with the creative bistro fare. The chef is a dab hand at reinventing Gallic classics, without forgetting his surprising ‘light’ version of pizza. Bold, spot-on cooking every time. We also recommend the next-door ice cream parlour....
